title: Arsenal target Nusa could cost £66m - Sunday's gossip
description: Arsenal could have to pay £66m for RB Leipzig's Antonio Nusa, Real Betis reject Chelsea's bid for Jose Morante, plus more.

title: Tearful Pochettino on 'difficult' decision to leave USA for Man Utd
description: An emotional Mauricio Pochettino broke down as he explained why he was leaving the USA to take the Manchester United job.

title: Arsenal dig in for draw at Barcelona to extend unbeaten start
description: Arsenal extend their unbeaten start to four matches in the Uefa Women's Champions League, as they produce a dogged display to hold Barcelona to a 1-1 draw at the Camp Nou. The point moves Renee Slegers' side into the top four, putting them in a great position to automatically qualify for the knockout stages.

title: Fernandes rejects second Man Utd contract offer
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes rejects the club's second contract offer, with his current deal due to expire at the end of the season.

title: From postcards to texts, the different ways a manager gets the sack - Pulis
description: BBC Sport columnist Tony Pulis explains some of the different ways a manager can leave a club, whether they have been sacked or resigned.

title: All done deals from September-November 2026
description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
description: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

title: Life as a Wag in the transfer window
description: What is life like for footballers' families during the transfer window where a last-minute deal means you need to uproot your life and move hundreds of miles?
